Question B-002-006-007.

Why the correct answer is right: One S-unit is 6 decibels (dB) in the stated convention. A 6 dB power reduction is a four-to-one drop, and one quarter of 100 W is 25 W.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "75 watts": 75 W is only a small reduction and would not drop one full 6 dB S-unit.
- sourceIndex 2: "50 watts": 50 W is a 3 dB reduction, about half of the 6 dB step.
- sourceIndex 3: "33 watts": 33 W is roughly a three-to-one drop, not the four-to-one ratio for one S-unit.
